subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Crypto Ponzi Schemes
description: A 60-second lesson on Crypto Ponzi Schemes.

hook.text: Cryptocurrency created a perfect storm for Ponzi schemes: hype, complexity, and no regulation.

buildup.text: Bitconnect promised 1% daily returns through a 'trading bot.' It raised $2.5 billion.

discovery.text: The trading bot didn't exist. Returns came from new investor deposits — classic Ponzi mechanics.

twist.text: When Bitconnect collapsed in 2018, investors lost everything. Many had mortgaged their homes.

climax.text: Dozens of crypto Ponzi schemes have followed, each using new jargon to disguise old fraud.

quiz.question: What was Bitconnect's supposed source of returns?
options: A trading bot that didn't exist
